# Pulse

> Pulse is a local-first desktop usage tracker and cost dashboard for Claude Code and OpenAI Codex subscriptions on Windows, macOS, and Linux. It uses Tauri 2, Rust, and Svelte 5, stores analytics in SQLite with FTS5 search, and publishes Discord Rich Presence through local IPC. Its provider access-lane model keeps subscription and API proof separate. Pulse sends no telemetry.

## Docs

- [Documentation index](docs/index.md): Guide to Pulse architecture, analytics, pricing, provider plans, notifications, and troubleshooting.
- [Release guide](docs/releasing.md): Local verification, versioning, packaging, signing, and release steps.
- [Development bridge](docs/architecture/dev-bridge.md): Debug-only authenticated loopback bridge between Vite and the Rust backend.
- [Discord assets](docs/discord-assets.md): Discord Developer Portal asset setup and Rich Presence image behavior.

## Configuration

- [Claude configuration](docs/troubleshooting.md): Claude data and configuration live under `~/.claude`, including `~/.claude/discord-presence-config.json` and `~/.claude/pulse-analytics.db`.
- [Codex plan configuration](docs/plan-detection.md): Codex reads plan and service-tier state from local files under `~/.codex`.
- [Codex Discord configuration](docs/codex-rich-presence-upstream.md): Codex Rich Presence configuration lives at `~/.codex/discord-presence-config.json`.
- [Provider access lanes](docs/architecture/adaptive-access.md): Subscription and API routes keep authentication proof, freshness, and analytics scope separate.
